scope: Closed, bijective constant renaming between axiom/definition/theorem views with an identical declared semantic profile. Source and destination theories must independently pass their actual kernel before any logical authority is claimed.
translation: Renames declaration and constant names; preserves universe parameters, literal payloads and binder/de Bruijn structure; recursively translates applications, lambdas, foralls and lets. Free locals, metavariables, loose bound variables, unknown universe parameters, unknown symbols and projections fail closed.
validation: Total unique source and destination symbol maps, exact axiom-map coverage and agreement, explicit source and destination axiom allowlists, and alpha-structural equality of actual translated types and bodies against destination declarations. Empty/changed identities and unknown features are rejected.
authority: The result is a syntactic relation with source/destination context, not CheckedCore or a theorem. preservation remains global-preservation-unproved. Artifact identity strings still require host byte binding.
focusedChecks: 19 Lean executable boundary cases, PSC1 check of 140 declarations, portable structural profile and all-portable source audit. These checks do not prove global translation preservation.
remaining: registered offline checker adapter and live kernel-bound inputs
general theory morphisms and explicit preservation certificates
